tr08.name: TR08

tr09.name: TR09

tr11.name: TR11

tr12.name: TR12

tr13.name: TR13

tr14.name: TR14

tr15.name: TR15

tr16.name: TR16

tr17.name: TR17

tr23.name: TR23

tr25.name: TR25

tr28.name: TR28

tr30.name: TR30

tr31.name: TR31

tr32.name: TR32

tr33.name: TR33

tr35.name: TR35

tr36.name: TR36

tr37.name: TR37

tr47.name: TR47

tr48.name: TR48

tr50.name: TR50

tr51.name: TR51

tr61.name: TR61

tr63.name: TR63

tr64.name: TR64

vs-seeker.name: Vs. Seeker
vs-seeker.shortDesc: Allows rebattling of on-screen trainers. 100 steps to recharge.

wacan-berry.name: Wacan Berry
wacan-berry.shortDesc: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Electric-type attack to halve the damage.

water-gem.name: Water Gem
water-gem.shortDesc: Held: When the holder uses a damaging Water-type move, the move has 1.5 power and this item is consumed.

water-memory.name: Water Memory
water-memory.shortDesc: Held: Changes Silvally to its Water form. Changes Multi-Attacks type to Water.

water-stone.name: Water Stone
water-stone.shortDesc: Evolves an Eevee into Vaporeon, a Lombre into Ludicolo, a Panpour into Simipour, a Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, a Shellder into Cloyster, or a Staryu into Starmie.

waterfall-charm.name: Waterfall Charm
waterfall-charm.shortDesc: Lets you use Waterfall without a Pokemon knowing it.

waterium-z--held.name: Waterium Z
waterium-z--held.shortDesc: Held: Allows a Pokemon to use the Z-move equivalents of its Water moves.

watmel-berry.name: Watmel Berry
watmel-berry.shortDesc: Used for creating PokeBlocks and Poffins.

wave-incense.name: Wave Incense
wave-incense.shortDesc: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Mantine begets a Mantyke Egg.

weakness-policy.name: Weakness Policy
weakness-policy.shortDesc: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

wellspring-mask.name: Wellspring Mask
wellspring-mask.shortDesc: Ogerpon-Wellspring: 1.2x power attacks; Terastallize to gain Embody Aspect.

wepear-berry.name: Wepear Berry
wepear-berry.shortDesc: Used for creating PokeBlocks and Poffins.

whipped-dream.name: Whipped Dream
whipped-dream.shortDesc: Traded on a Swirlix: Holder evolves into Slurpuff.

whirlpool-charm.name: Whirlpool Charm
whirlpool-charm.shortDesc: Lets you use Whirlpool without a Pokemon knowing it.

white-apricorn.name: White Apricorn
white-apricorn.shortDesc: Used to make a Fast Ball.

white-flute.name: White Flute
white-flute.shortDesc: Doubles the wild Pokemon encounter rate.

white-herb.name: White Herb
white-herb.shortDesc: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.

white-mane-hair.name: White Mane Hair
white-mane-hair.shortDesc: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

wide-lens.name: Wide Lens
wide-lens.shortDesc: Held: Provides a 1/10 (10%) boost in accuracy to the holder.

wiki-berry.name: Wiki Berry
wiki-berry.shortDesc: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokemon that dislike dry flavor.

wise-glasses.name: Wise Glasses
wise-glasses.shortDesc: Held: Boosts the damage of special moves used by the holder by 1/10 (10%).

wishing-chip.name: Wishing Chip
wishing-chip.shortDesc: Toss a number of them into a Pokemon Den for the chance to attract a wild Dynamax Pokemon.

wishing-piece.name: Wishing Piece
wishing-piece.shortDesc: Throw one into a Pokemon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokemon.

wishing-star.name: Wishing Star
wishing-star.shortDesc: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. Its said that your dreams come true if you find one.

wooden-crown.name: Wooden Crown
wooden-crown.shortDesc: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe its meant to be part of something.

x-accuracy.name: X Accuracy
x-accuracy.shortDesc: Raises accuracy by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

x-defense.name: X Defense
x-defense.shortDesc: Raises Defense by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

x-sp-atk.name: X Sp. Atk
x-sp-atk.shortDesc: Raises Special Attack by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

x-sp-def.name: X Sp. Def
x-sp-def.shortDesc: Raises Special Defense by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

x-speed.name: X Speed
x-speed.shortDesc: Raises Speed by one stage in battle. Raises happiness.

yache-berry.name: Yache Berry
yache-berry.shortDesc: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Ice-type attack to halve the damage.

yellow-apricorn.name: Yellow Apricorn
yellow-apricorn.shortDesc: Used to make a Moon Ball.

yellow-scarf.name: Yellow Scarf
yellow-scarf.shortDesc: Raises the holders Toughness while in a contest.

yellow-shard.name: Yellow Shard
yellow-shard.shortDesc: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.

z-ring.name: Z-Ring
z-ring.shortDesc: Allows the players Pokemon to use Z-moves.

zap-plate.name: Zap Plate
zap-plate.shortDesc: Held: Electric-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceuss and Judgments type to Electric.

zeraorite.name: Zeraorite
zeraorite.shortDesc: If held by a Zeraora, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.

zoom-lens.name: Zoom Lens
zoom-lens.shortDesc: Held: Provides a 1/5 (20%) boost in accuracy if the holder moves after the target.

zygarde-cube.name: Zygarde Cube
zygarde-cube.shortDesc: Contains collected Zygarde cells/cores. Can teach Zygarde moves.

zygardite.name: Zygardite
zygardite.shortDesc: If held by a Zygarde in Complete Forme, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.
